book.name: Hibru
book.title: Saveeŋ To Timbooda Ila To Yes Hibrua Hibru—Hebrews

content: Krisi ineep toman Maaron izi sambam ve ighamgham uraat toni
Saveeŋ to nisasavia ne, pughu tovene: Aazne, iit leed daba poia eez to watooŋrau. Ye ineep ila Maaron ariaŋa nima waan igharau ina to ghamuuŋ pooz to sambam we. Mk 16:19; Ep 1:20; Hib 1:3

Ye ineep ilooŋ ila mbeez patabuaŋ to iyoon izi sambam, ve ighamgham uraat toni to watooŋrau ila lolo to patabuaŋ le patabuaŋ kat. Mbeez tonowen, nene mbeez tau. Tamtoghon to taan tipayoonda maau. Maaron tau ipayoonda.

Daba tisob to watooŋrau, tighur di, leso tighur paitooŋ to tamtoghon ila pa Maaron ve tigham uraat pa watooŋrau todi. Daba toit to watooŋrau tovene paam. Irau nima moghon ve ila to Maaron ne maau. Ye irau ikis mbeb eta ve ila tomani, leso igham pani inim watooŋrau. Hib 5:1, 9:12
Ighaze Yesu inepneep izi taan, ye irau inim ŋgeu to watooŋrau maau. Pasa, watooŋrau naol to tutuuŋ to Mose isavia di, tamtoghona tineep pataghaaŋ wa pa tigham uraat padi.

Eemoghon yes timbesmbees pa Maaron ilooŋ ila mbeez to taan moghon. Mbeez tonowen, mbeb tau maau. Nene mbeez to iyoon izi sambam we anunu moghon. Pasa, sawa to Mose ighaze ipayoon mbeez patabuaŋ to Maaron izi ndug balim, Maaron isaav ariaŋa pani ighaze: “Mbeez anunu to napatooŋa payom izi lolooz, matam kisini ve ugharaat mbeb tisob titaghoni.” Igham 40:1+; Mbaŋ 7:44; Kol 2:17; Hib 10:1

Ve aazne, uraat to watooŋrau to Maaron ighuri ila Yesu nima, nene poia kat ilib pa uraat to watooŋrau to muuŋ. Ve ataam paghu to itiŋa Maaron talup ghiit tanim ee moghon, tovene paam. Nene poia kat ilib pa ataam muŋgina, ve le saveeŋ mbuaaŋ popoiadi kat. Ataam paghu tonowen ivot ila uraat to Krisi. Pasa ye to iyoon bodbodaaŋ pa Maaron ve iit tamtoghon. 2Kor 3:6+; Hib 7:22
Inimale ataam muŋgina tonowen poia kat, ve le pataŋani eta maau, tone irau Maaron irabolini pa ataam paghu tonene maau. Hib 7:11,18, 10:1
Eemoghon Maaron ighita tovene: Moghon moghon tamtoghon toni tiyel pa ataam toni ve tighamgham sosor. Tauto ye isaav ighaze:

content.text: “Alooŋ. Sawa eta pale ivot, ghoro you naghur ataam paghu pa yes Israela ve yes Yuda,

content: leso yeiŋa nilup ghei ninim ee moghon. Yer 31:31+

content.text: Ataam paghu tonene, pale ite pa ataam to naghuri pa nditimbudi. Muuŋ, sawa to nakis yes Israela nimadi ve naghereb di tipul Isip, you navotia ataam muŋgina tonowen padi. Eemoghon titaghoni kat maau. Tauto naghur murig padi.

Ataam paghu to pale naghuri padi, nene vene: Muri, you taug pale naghur tutuuŋ tiou ineep ariaŋa ila ŋgar todi ve nambooda ila lolodi. Ve you pale nanim Maaron todi, ve yes tinim tamtoghon tiou. Ezek 36:25+; 2Kor 3:3; Hib 10:16
Sawa tonenen ighaze ivot, tamtoghon eta irau ipatoot ndita pa saveeŋ tiou muul maau.

Ve tamtoghon eta irau isaav pa toŋvetaz toni ighaze: ‘Oyai, yam awatag Maaron, ghoro poia!’ vene maau. Pasa, yes tisob pale tiwatag katin ghou. Yes to ledi izadi maau, ve yes to izadi tintina ne paam. Is 54:13; Yo 6:45
Ve you pale lolog isamin di ve nareua sosor todi isob ilale, ve matag iŋgali muul maau.” Ro 11:27; Hib 10:17

content: Aghita. Ighaze Maaron isavia ataam paghu eta, nene ipatooŋ ghiit ighaze ataam to ivot muuŋ, nene muŋginaaŋ ve igharau ighaze isob. Ataam tovene, mala maau pale ilale kat. Ro 10:4; Hib 7:18

footnotes.text: Sawa to yes Israela tineep izi lolooz Sinai pughu, tigharaat mbeez eez inim inadi to suŋuuŋ. Saveeŋa ineep ila Maaron Igham Mulin Yes Israela, ŋgat 25 ila 31 ve ŋgat 36 ila 40. Saveeŋ waaro tonene, isavia mbeez tau to ineep izi sambam.

Sawa to Kinik Solomon natu Reoboam iŋgin yes Israela, yes tivalag di tinim ru. Yes to tineep ila pa kagu, tiwaat di Israela. Ve yes to tineep ila pa daudau, tiwaat di Yuda. Eemoghon muri tilup di muul. Tauto sawa to Yesu, tiwaat di tighaze ‘Israel,’ ve tiwaat di ‘Yuda’ paam.
